name: Jezero HiRISE controlled mosaic
description: 20 WMTS tiles acquired 2026-11-14 from published capabilities. ROI 77.40–77.48 E, 18.42–18.49 N; matrix 13. Texture cached locally. Effective WMTS sample spacing about 5.09 m; 0.25 m source product is not the rendered resolution.

name: Jezero CTX 20 m elevation model
description: USGS/NASA CTX 20 m DEM acquired by bounded HTTP range requests (8,015,040 bytes). Cropped GeoTIFF drives the 3D terrain, slopes, A* and SVNet scenarios. Native Mars sphere, equirectangular standard parallel 18.4663 degrees; planetocentric/east-positive. UI resampled to about 47.35 × 43.68 m. Local Atlas relief uses a north-up hillshade rendered from the native Jezero planner mesh.

name: Geologic map of Jezero and Nili Planum
description: Geological motivation for sedimentary and crater-floor investigations. Proposed waypoints have not been intersected with mapped units; they are assumed study targets.

name: Mars 2020 Perseverance rover
description: Original GLB downloaded; all materials replaced with neutral material at rendering to remove texture-based insignia. Animation is kinematic, with enlarged character scale.

name: Astronaut
description: Static GLB with procedural bob/sway, not a biomechanics rig. All textured materials replaced in renderer.

name: Perseverance Mastcam-Z regional context
description: NASA products PIA24485 (Sol 4) and PIA25212 (Sol 406) cached on science cards. Regional context only; not registered to proposed stop coordinates.

name: NASA Worldview
description: Earth imagery; not a Mars basemap.

name: Curiosity Mount Sharp route
status: REFERENCE ONLY / NOT USED AS DATA
description: A different landing site; not Jezero terrain.

name: 404-SVNet v1.0 trained models
description: Three-member gradient-boosted ensemble, 31 public pre-action features; separate spatial train, validation, calibration and test regions. No real astronaut safety outcomes.
